messages.text: Clear skies and a touch of the cosmos
A crisp autumn day offers mostly clear skies and mild temperatures. Look up for the Draconids meteor shower or explore local and regional arts events.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 49°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:39 AM, sunset at 7:03 PM, with the moon in its waning crescent phase, 6.6% illuminated.
In Ypsilanti, the EMU Theatre presents 'Metamorphoses' at the Sponberg Theatre. In Detroit, the Detroit Opera House hosts 'Detroit Story Fest 2026: Villains' at 7:30 PM.
Pop's birthday is coming up on October 12.
State funding flows to workforce development and health initiatives

Several state initiatives are set to receive significant funding. Over $1.9 million is allocated for child caring institution infrastructure, and $1.5 million will go to the Lenawee Now Foundation for workforce development.
Tomorrow brings history tours and music
Tomorrow in Northville, the Oakwood Cemetery Tours offer a historical perspective. Music lovers can catch Scythian at The Ark in Ann Arbor.
Satellites test autonomous navigation, Hubble finds ancient merger

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras. Meanwhile, the Hubble telescope has identified a major merger event from the Milky Way's early history.
The next Starship launch is estimated no earlier than September 18, 2026, though this is not an official SpaceX schedule.
The sky offers a quiet invitation to look up.
